faq.a: No public one. Paste any kleinanzeigen.de search link (cars, real estate, electronics, with every filter) or use keyword + city, and get each ad as structured data.

faq.q: Can I tell private sellers from businesses?
faq.a: Yes. Each ad says whether the seller is private or commercial; seller details such as rating and active listings can be added.

faq.q: Can I use it as a Kleinanzeigen API?
faq.a: Yes. Start a run from your own code with Apify's REST API (or the JavaScript and Python clients) and read the results as JSON; the run-sync endpoint returns the items in the same HTTP call. The same input also runs in the Apify Console, on a schedule, or from Make, Zapier and n8n.

officialApi: Kleinanzeigen.de has no public API. This actor reads its public search results for any search link or keyword and city.
